checks.name: Tile ID Exact Match
checks.requirement: Evaluated tile IDs match exactly the 107 development IDs from the split manifest.
checks.evidence: Set of 107 tile IDs in per_tile_metrics.csv matches development_tiles in split_manifest.json with 0 differences.

checks.name: Holdout and Quarantine Isolation
checks.requirement: No holdout or quarantined tile appears in the evaluation.
checks.evidence: Intersection with holdout partition (107 tiles) is empty (0 tiles). Intersection with quarantined partition (42 tiles) is empty (0 tiles).

checks.name: Consistent Preprocessing and Registration Shifts
checks.requirement: Each method uses the same reference image, evaluation crop, channel order, pixel scaling, and fixed per-tile registration shift.
checks.evidence: Inspection of run_phase2_evaluation.py (L130-L171) shows naip_img normalized /255.0, integer shifts (dx, dy) loaded from EXP-014 npz, and identical ref_crop applied to all arms.
checks.calculation_method: Code inspection of evaluation loop in run_phase2_evaluation.py

checks.name: Six-Prediction Ensemble Construction Consistency
checks.requirement: Six-prediction ensemble constructed consistently from S0, S1, S3, S4, S5, and S6.
checks.evidence: Confirmed strategies = ["S0", "S1", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6"] loaded, stacked as (6, 128, 128, 3), and averaged via np.mean(stack_preds, axis=0) (L143-L151).
checks.calculation_method: Code inspection of ensemble aggregation in run_phase2_evaluation.py

checks.name: Deterministic Ranking and Tie Handling
checks.requirement: Hybrid and Sobel masks select specified top 10%, 20%, 30% using deterministic tie handling.
checks.evidence: np.lexsort((np.arange(total_pixels), -u_hyb_flat)) explicitly resolves identical scores via unique ascending pixel index order. Pixel replacement budgets (1440, 2880, 4320) are exact.
checks.calculation_method: Verification of np.lexsort implementation in run_phase2_evaluation.py (L200-L203)

checks.name: Random Mask Seed Recording and Multi-Seed Aggregation
checks.requirement: Random masks use recorded seeds, and results from all five seeds are aggregated correctly.
checks.evidence: Random seeds [101, 202, 303, 404, 505] evaluated per tile with deterministic seed formula (r_seed + idx * 1000). Mean, std, min, and max across 5 seeds recorded in CSV.
checks.calculation_method: Verification of random seed loop in run_phase2_evaluation.py (L236-L260)

checks.name: Mask Selectivity and Unchanged Exterior Pixels
checks.requirement: Replacement masks affect only intended pixels, and original S0 pixels remain unchanged elsewhere.
checks.evidence: img_hyb = s0_crop.copy(); img_hyb[hyb_mask_2d] = ens_crop[hyb_mask_2d] guarantees pixels where mask is False retain exact S0 values without modification.
checks.calculation_method: Code inspection of array assignment logic (L213-L214, L227-L228, L245-L246)

checks.name: Statistical Metric Reproducibility from Saved Results
checks.requirement: MAE, PSNR, paired differences, confidence intervals, p-values, effect sizes, and win/loss counts reproduced from saved per-tile results.
checks.evidence: Independent recomputation from per_tile_metrics.csv matched all reported metrics across all 37 comparisons in aggregate_statistics.csv to floating-point precision.
checks.calculation_method: Automated numerical verification using scipy.stats ttest_rel, wilcoxon, and numpy arrays

checks.name: Zero Ground-Truth Residual Leakage in Mask Construction
checks.requirement: Implementation did not use reference-image residuals to construct uncertainty maps or select pixels.
checks.evidence: Uncertainty maps are constructed from z_tta (TTA variance) and z_input (temporal variance) strictly prior to reference error computation. NAIP reference is accessed solely for evaluation.
checks.calculation_method: Code inspection of variable dependencies in run_phase2_evaluation.py (L134-L171)

checks.name: Gradient Sharpness Accounting and Non-Claim Compliance
checks.requirement: Reported edge-gradient statistics calculated consistently and not presented as proof of perceptual quality.
checks.evidence: Sobel gradient magnitude and gradient MAE vs reference evaluated across all arms. Report explicitly states lower MAE/higher PSNR represents variance reduction rather than enhanced super-resolution.
checks.calculation_method: Textual and code verification of EXP020A_PHASE2_REPORT.md and run_phase2_evaluation.py
